shots.p: medium shot at night, an Arab man in a dim mud-brick room secretly handing a sealed letter to a hooded rider, lamplight flickering, tense guilty expression
wide shot of the same rider galloping away across moonlit desert toward a distant hostile city, dust trailing
low angle on a line of hostile armed horsemen on a ridge at dawn, banners dark against a stormy sky, menacing silence
close-up of a believer's worried face realizing the friends he trusted wish him to abandon his faith
a lone Arab man standing in a vast empty plain at dusk, his family drifting away into the haze behind him, each walking a separate path
wide shot of a small group of ordinary believers walking away from a temple full of stone idols, desert sunrise ahead, firm resolute posture
close-up of toppled carved idols lying in sand, shadows long, the group's footprints leading away toward light
a small circle of believers praying at night under a vast starry sky, hands raised, humble faces lit by a single lantern
a winding desert path with fresh footprints of a group ahead leading toward a bright dawn horizon, a traveler following in their steps
two Arab families once estranged embracing in a village courtyard at golden hour, children smiling, old tension melting into warmth
a Muslim man warmly offering dates and water to a peaceful non-Muslim neighbor at his doorstep, soft afternoon light, mutual respect
close-up of a balanced brass scale on a market table, sunlight on it, symbol of fairness
medium shot of a believer firmly closing a door on hostile men who had driven his people from their homes, burnt-out houses in background, grave mood
wide shot of veiled women in long modest robes arriving at the gates of a walled town at sunset, weary from a long journey, carrying bundles
a modest elder questioning one veiled woman gently in a courtyard, she answers with sincere calm face
a modest bundle of coins and fabric being handed over between two men in a tent as compensation, lamplight, solemn fairness
a large group of modestly veiled women standing together in a sunlit courtyard pledging with raised resolute faces, viewed from behind, peaceful sincerity
a lone man looking hopelessly over an old silent graveyard at dusk, cold wind, grey sky, despair on his face
